end.text: Adverbs are also used to show how likely something is to happen.

atoms.b: ((Maybe)) if you did your homework, you would understand the topic.
I am ((definitely)) going to the birthday party.
I will ((probably)) not have time to cook tonight.
((Perhaps)) I will go to London tomorrow.
I will ((certainly)) look after your dog when you’re away.

instruction.text: Antonio had a conversation with Sam. Throughout the conversation they made a number of statements. Decide whether the statements they made are certain or uncertain.

atoms.sound: I will definitely go to the party on Friday.
Maybe I will have time to meet you tonight.
Obviously I haven’t told him yet.
I could possibly make it to the party tonight!
Perhaps you left your phone on the train?
I will certainly look after your cat this weekend.
It is unlikely that you will fail the test.
